question: Which royal identity and universal dominion are affirmed for Rāma here?
premises: He is identified as the son of Daśaratha.
He is the refuge of all jewels and a king.
inference: Rāma, son of Daśaratha, is affirmed as a world-ruling and treasure-bearing king.
plain_english: The world-subduing son of Daśaratha is the king, the refuge of all jewels.
